item.title: Commuter Council Tabling
item.description: Come learn about the Commuter Council and what we do in exchange for a raffle ticket for our end of year raffle.

item.title: Financial Aid CARE Package II
item.description: Students will learn about credit building, debt repayment, auto loans, and overall financial wellness with David Kinstle; Branch Manager from Polish National Credit Union. Bluetooth speakers will be given out as prizes!

item.title: Emotional CARE Package
item.description: Join CARE Ambassador: Lorraine Fernandez, as she leads a workshop based on stress management, relaxation techniques, and practicing mindfulness as we head into finals! Snacks will be provided, all students are invited to attend!

item.title: Feminist Fair
item.description: The EGST Department celebrates Women's Month with the Feminist Fair!! Come join us for our annual event focusing on the struggles and triumphs of women worldwide, which is organized by our students. Monday, March 30 11:30 am to 12:30 pm &amp; 1:40 pm to 4:30 pm and Tuesday, March 31 from 11:30 am to 2:00 pm in the Ely Main Lounge 110. Refreshments will be served!

item.title: Shamrock Shakes
item.description: Come learn about and celebrate the history of Ireland and St Patrick’s Day! Free Shamrock Shakes at the Newhall front desk!

item.title: Drop In Zine Workshop at Ely Library
item.description: Join us for a drop-in zine workshop at Ely Library! All materials will be provided, and you do not need to know anything about zines to participate! We hope to see you there!

item.title: The One With The Wellness Day
item.description: Join CAB and come take a break and unwind with yoga, DIY stress balls, massage chairs, tea, iced coffee and iced tea bars, and some assorted sweets. The first 20 students can also grab a spot at the barbershop, so bring your FRIENDS!

item.title: Barbershop
item.description: CAB is sponsoring a barbershop experience with Jose Dones! The first 20 students will be able to get a fresh cut, so don’t miss out!

item.title: Cozy Study Night
item.description: Join BPM Aidan and enjoy some tea, and calming music while you get some work done.

item.title: Lifetime Owls BINGO
item.description: Hey Lifetime Owls! Don't miss out on our exciting BINGO event, it's the ultimate campus activity you won't want to miss! Join us on April 14 in the MPR room at University Hall for a night of fun, prizes, FOOD, and good times. Gather your Lifetime Owl friends, bring your luck, and get ready for an unforgettable evening. See you there!

item.title: Reading for remembering and understanding
item.description: Have you ever read for an hour and not remembered much of what you read? Do you read the same line or paragraph over and over again and still not understand what you just read? Reading alone is not enough for most people to process and learn information. The reading material needs to processed, summarized, and discussed to understand and remember it. Come learn some strategies and techniques to make the most of your reading time. Hosted by peer mentor Chris

item.title: Health Humanities Write-In
item.description: We’ll look at art, talk and enjoy each other’s company, and write and be creative together.You’re welcome if you have an active writing practice or if you can’t remember the last time you wrote creatively.Students, staff and faculty from all areas are welcome.

item.title: All Out! Community Leadership Meeting
item.description: Stop by to learn more about and help plan the future community events for All Out! @ Westfield State University! Work cooperatively with the sitting E-board and understand what is happening within the club, as well as the club's future plans!

item.title: Adaptive Eating OTA event
item.description: Come join the OTA club for our first event in April (OT month) to learn how to use tools for adaptive eating! Enjoy some free fresh fruit and veggies while learning something new!
